title: Pure Scareclaw
summary: Scareclaw cards plus the Visas Starfrost they name, with generic Links and staples. Scareclaws are Defense Position monsters that summon themselves into the Main Monster Zone next to or below another Scareclaw. Three of them become Scareclaw Tri-Heart, which turns every monster on the field to Defense Position and ignores Defense Position monsters' effects. Scareclaw Reichheart searches a Scareclaw Spell/Trap. Primitive Planet Reichphobia searches a Scareclaw or Visas Starfrost and destroys a card once three Defense Position monsters are out. Scareclaw Light-Heart, a Link-1, searches Reichphobia. Scareclaw Defanging, the newest card, makes your Scareclaw Links and Visas untargetable and indestructible by their effects and banishes what they destroy in battle. Scareclaw Kashtira summons itself on either Main Phase and attacks from Defense Position.
